changes.title: Runestone sigils
items: The sigils on the runestones are crisp, clean lines now, a bright neon inlay in a dark carved groove, easy to make out by day and by night

changes.title: Stargaze camera
items: Lying on the sand to stargaze, the island's treeline stands on the horizon under the sky instead of a hard edge into black
Walking down to the sea, the camera lowers and the world curves away, until lying on the sand the night sky fills most of the screen
The waves are only heard near the sea

changes.title: Canopy hole organic
items: No more round window in the canopy round you on the ground: the trees thin out crown by crown, each tree and its trunk fading as one, with a ragged edge that drifts slowly and leans the way you're flying
